parsed.explanation: Rating 0.48. The unrepealed same-sex statute is a secondary climate signal because no recent enforcement is documented. The more relevant exposure is the gender-expression public-solicitation/impersonation offence, which could be applied to visible trans presentation, but there is no evidence of arrests or visitor-facing enforcement. The dossier reports fear, homophobia and one activist killing, and gives no recognition/anti-discrimination protections, but those are climate/resident gaps rather than documented traveler restrictions. No border screening, facility ban, custody rule or organized targeting is recorded. Traditional third-gender acceptance reduces the worst-case reading. The thin record is extrapolated above high risk but below reduced risk because a trans-specific law plus weak recourse makes consequences after outing material.
